NotFound.description: Not found (also used for content the caller may not see)

RateLimited.description: Too many requests; see the Retry-After header

ageCookie.description: Signed age-gate cookie set by POST /api/v1/age/verify.
ageCookie.name: xh_age

sessionCookie.description: Session cookie set by POST /api/v1/auth/login. Unsafe methods also need an allowed Origin (CSRF).
sessionCookie.name: xh_session

streamToken.description: Not a query parameter: the token is the first path segment of /stream/{token}/... and is issued by GET /api/v1/videos/{id}.
streamToken.name: token
